question_text: Compare the average head_count at KeynoteHall_Stage between the morning keynote window 09:00-10:00 UTC and the afternoon keynote window 14:00-15:00 UTC on 2025-12-08. Which keynote had higher attendance and what were the approximate average head_counts?
answer_text: The morning keynote had higher attendance with an average head count of 450.19, compared to the afternoon keynote's average of 399.51.

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'KeynoteHall_Stage'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T09:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T10:00:00Z'
  RETURN avg(ch.avg_hc) AS morning_avg_hc
}
CALL {
  MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'KeynoteHall_Stage'})
  WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T14:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T15:00:00Z'
  RETURN avg(ch.avg_hc) AS afternoon_avg_hc
}
RETURN morning_avg_hc, afternoon_avg_hc, 
       CASE 
         WHEN morning_avg_hc > afternoon_avg_hc THEN 'Morning Keynote had higher attendance'
         WHEN afternoon_avg_hc > morning_avg_hc THEN 'Afternoon Keynote had higher attendance'
         ELSE 'Both keynotes had equal attendance'
       END AS comparison
